Introduction

Taeyong is a South Korean rapper under SM Entertainment. He is the leader of NCT and a member of its sub-units NCT U and NCT 127, as well as the supergroup SuperM. Formerly part of the trainee team SMROOKIES, he debuted on April 8, 2016 with NCT U's single "The 7th Sense", followed by NCT 127's debut in July 2016.

In July 2019, he released his first solo track, “Long Flight”, which he co-wrote and co-composed. That same year, he joined SuperM, debuting with their self-titled mini-album in October. On June 5th of 2019, Taeyong made his official solo debut, with the mini album "SHALALA".

Being the first NCT member to enlist, Taeyong enlisted in the Navy as an active-duty solder on April 15, 2024. He is expected to be discharged by December 14, 2025.
